OK
train?
enter anger stance and never leave.

Here's how she works
Red stance- more damage

Blue stance- more shield/heals

Yellow stance- more ult charge

Purple stance-more strength gain, More poison/counter gained/applied

You enter the stance after using the card's respective stance first each turn 

The bonus scales with her death resistance
That's the short of it, you mostly don't bother with changing stances most of the time after putting the one your team wants

She's actually really easy

Strike / Snarl Psalm 
- When placed into Ultra Space / played as the first Card in a Turn
- L Changes Stance to Anger 
- L Raises the Final Damage of all Awakeners in your Team 
- L Grants additional Crit Rate & Crit Damage after casting Exalt
- When played, applies Vulnerable

Defense / Elegy Psalm 
- When placed into Ultra Space / played as the first Card in a Turn 
- L Changes Stance to Grief  
- Raises the Shield Generation, Health Recovery and Strength Reduction of all Awakener in your Team 
- L Raises the Health Recovery provided by Exalt 
- When played, applies Weakness 

0-Cost / Carol Psalm
- Choose an Awakener to grant Aliemus to
This is all you need to know, ignore everything else
